summary: Moniker's one-screen Svelte app for Gestures, a sans in four weights where every letter has a scribbly hand-drawn alternate. The whole site is a tester: a screenplay line set huge in the middle, one slider at the bottom whose target is picked from 'Size / Weight / Alt characters', a dark-mode switch and green/blue pill buttons. Per the info text, filmed hands of the designer (WebGL canvas, with voice-over and a mute button) reach in and drag the settings back to the intended values; all copy lives in an info panel.

instances.look: No bar, just floating pill buttons in the corners: a green 'Gestures ▾' style dropdown top-left; a blue 'buy', a green round speaker (mute) button and a green 'info' top-right

A light-grey screen with 'INT. IDENTITY TRAINING FACILITY–DAY' (a screenplay scene heading, with one scribbly 'T' alternate) centred in two lines of thin black Gestures; along the bottom 'Dark mode' with a toggle, then the words 'Size', 'Weight', 'Alt characters:' (the active one underlined) and one long grey slider with a white round thumb
instances.feel: Quiet stage set waiting for a performance
instances.ux: Pick Size, Weight or Alt characters, then drag the single slider: Alt characters swaps a growing share of letters for their scribbly siblings (0–1); the dropdown picks the weight; dark mode inverts the page; the designer's filmed hands (canvas video, with spoken voices) come in and drag the values back, and the mute button silences them
instances.learn: One slider whose target is chosen by plain-word radio labels keeps the screen almost empty; a percentage slider for alternates shows a feature as a dose, not an on/off switch

reconstruction.layout: Single 1440×900 screen, no scroll; sample centred both ways, max ~1260px wide; corner pills 16–24px from the edges, ~48px tall; bottom row at y≈845: 'Dark mode' + 40×20 toggle at x≈64, radio labels from x≈320, slider track from x≈740 to 1375 (2px grey, thumb 21px white circle with grey ring); canvas layer above for hand video
reconstruction.typography: Sample font-size calc(var(--vh) × 68.9) × 18% ≈ 112px at 900px tall, Gestures weight 80 (thin), letter-spacing 0, line-height 1.1, all caps with 'case' feature on the dash; UI ~24px grotesk (Gestures Regular) black on pills
reconstruction.behaviour: Radio selects which property (fontSize, fontWeight, fontAltChars) the mdc-slider drives (step 0.0001); alternates appear letter by letter as the value rises; dark mode swaps --black/--white; scripted hand videos on a WebGL canvas reset the settings, with voice lines (mutable); idle capture showed no motion
reconstruction.content: A screenplay ('INT. IDENTITY TRAINING FACILITY–DAY'), with voices credited as characters 'Anatomia' and 'The Greatfisher'
reconstruction.assets: Filmed hand video assets (sold separately as 'Gestures Video Assets'), voice recordings, the Gestures font with alternates
reconstruction.html: .text-container > .text[style=font-size: calc(var(--vh)*68.9)] > div[style=font-size:18%; font-weight:80] > p; .bottom > #dark-btn, .selectors > input[type=radio]#size|#weight|#alt + label, #alt-slider.mdc-slider[role=slider]; canvas#canvas

instances.look: Hidden panel (#info-text, off-canvas at -100vw, captured in HTML only) opened by the 'info' pill: the description with a few letters set as scribbly alternates, 'download a PDF specimen', the story of Moniker's first own typeface, a mailto for a free trial, a link to buy the hand video assets, and full credits
instances.ux: Slides in from the left over the tester; links to the PDF specimen, mailto trial request, shop page for video assets
instances.learn: Sprinkle the font's alternates into the about text itself (one per sentence) so even the copy demonstrates the feature

reconstruction.layout: Full-height panel sliding in from the left (translateX(-100vw) → 0); paragraphs with margin-bottom classes mb / mb-2
reconstruction.typography: Body in Gestures Regular ~24px, span.alt letters in the scribbly alternate, links underlined
reconstruction.content: Description, PDF specimen link, studio story, trial by email, 'Jolana's own hands annoyingly change the settings back… They are sold separately here ↓', credits (concept, typeface design, development, hand assets, voices, kerning)
reconstruction.html: div#info-text > p (span.alt for alternate glyphs, span.case)
